messages:
Tara: Heads-up: scheduled quiet-window tilt for router-gateway at 04:00 UTC. Plan: incremental cut 5->20->50->100, 4m waits. Gate: errors <0.6% and p95 < 600ms.
Ben: Ack. Release notes updated. We also need to pin legacy-auth traffic until session header propagated.
Olga: Which token header are we toggling? Make sure SDKs won't break.
Tara: Toggle X-Model-Version header to 'g2'. SDKs fall back to header absence, so should be fine. We'll add a 10m dual-read grace after 100%.
DeployBot: routeshift:start id=rs-20240630-22 payload={"from":"blue-20240630","to":"green-g2","steps":[5,20,50,100],"wait":"4m","header":"X-Model-Version"} initiated by Tara at 1751239999
DeployBot: step 1 complete 5% traffic to green. metrics: errors=0.18%, p95=240ms.
Ben: Seeing a slight spike in ap-south p95 to 420ms, but errors still low. Tagging SRE-Lead.
SRE-Lead: Monitor 10m. If errors >0.5% or p95 > 600ms for 3m we hold.
DeployBot: step 2 complete 0% traffic to green. metrics: errors=0.25%, p95=260ms.
Olga: ap-south p95 creeping to 510ms and a couple timeouts from pool-ap-south-2.
Infra-Bot: Alert: pool-ap-south-2 avg connect-timeout=1200ms for last 120s.
Tara: Pause global progression. Apply region-pin for ap-south to blue and investigate. @DeployBot region-pin id=rs-20240630-22 region=ap-south to=blue reason="connect timeouts"
DeployBot: region-pin applied for ap-south. Global shift paused at 20%.
Ben: Rolling back the new v2 instances in that pool to previous kernel. Olga, can you start the rollback?
Olga: Initiating rollback for pool-ap-south-2 instances [inst-81,inst-82]. ETA ~2m.
DeployBot: rollback:pool completed for pool-ap-south-2. Instances reverted.
Infra-Bot: pool-ap-south-2 health OK. connect-timeout cleared.
SRE-Lead: ap-south metrics stable for 4m. Recommend waiting 6m before unpin.
Tara: Agreed. Holding for full 10m window. Amanda (cc) will add note in release docs about regional pin and pool rollback.
Ben: Once ap-south stable and p95 < 400ms for 10m we resume.
DeployBot: admin:resume requires manual approval.
Tara: Will resume here when ready. Leaving thread open. :white_check_mark:
